artifact_review: The Router's severity ratings for blur (4) and structural collapse (3) are accurate and perhaps even conservative. The Perceptual Quality Auditor underestimated the blur (reporting 'slight compression'), likely due to the low-resolution input masking the high-frequency loss. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask is misleading here; it simply segmented the blob, not verifying its structural integrity. The fusion artifact is the critical failure mode.
